items.title: Set a weekly coffee limit
items.description: Limit yourself to two coffees out per week. This targets the frequent small impulse purchases associated with Present Bias.

items.title: Consolidate Entertainment Subscriptions
items.description: Review your streaming subscriptions and pause or cancel at least two that you use the least.

items.title: Automate Monthly Savings Transfer
items.description: Set up an automatic transfer of $120 to your savings account on the day you receive your paycheck. This uses the 'pay yourself first' method.
